settings.title: Settings
settings.dates.title: Trip dates
settings.dates.hint: The dates are saved with the trip. Re-planning the route by date comes in stage 3.
settings.theme.title: Appearance
settings.backup.title: Backup and restore
settings.backup.text: A JSON file with all your data. Keep it outside the browser, for example in Files or Drive.
settings.reset.title: Start over
settings.reset.text: Deletes all data on this device. Export a backup first.
settings.install.title: Add to home screen
settings.install.text: Once installed, the app opens like a regular app and works without a connection.
settings.install.iphone: On iPhone: open in Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
settings.install.android: On Android: tap the button below. If it does not show, open the browser menu and choose "Install app".
settings.install.done: The app is installed on this device.
settings.storage.title: Saving on this device
settings.storage.persisted: The browser granted persistent storage. It will not clear the data on its own.
settings.storage.notPersisted: The browser did not grant persistent storage. Installing to the home screen and backing up keep your data safe.
settings.storage.unknown: This browser does not report whether storage is persistent.
settings.storage.off: Saving on this device is blocked right now.
settings.limits.title: App limits
settings.limits.device: Data is saved only on this device.
settings.limits.sync: There is no sync between friends or devices. Share through a backup file.
settings.limits.encryption: Data is not encrypted. Do not save passport numbers or card details here.
settings.limits.iphone: On iPhone you must add the app to the home screen. Otherwise Safari may clear the data after a few days without use.
settings.version.title: Version

import.err.structure: The backup file is incomplete or damaged. Nothing was changed.
import.err.future: The backup comes from a newer version. Update the app and try again.
import.err.read: The file could not be read.
reset.title: Reset all data
reset.text: The trip, the settings and everything you entered will be deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
